title: PR-73 re-scorer over the three arms reports — from the notes sidecar and from the entry MIDIs alone (Wave Q — Model Discovery, PR-74)
why: The runner skips a token-named MIDI that already exists and the pair tokens are deterministic hashes, so repeated launches into one directory can leave files from a superseded draw. Before this check every entry MIDI of the three sets was re-rendered from its run's notes sidecar with writeEntryMidi() (rewrite: classical 0 files changed, global 6, held-out 9 — the remaining files were already byte-identical to the sidecar's rendering). The sidecar is the record; this file says how faithfully the MIDIs reproduce it.
